mechanism_narrative: If WORKPLACES keeps edging up while TRANSIT remains less negative, weekday trip chaining and lunch-time discretionary stops should increase RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks. The effect is strongest when the gains are sustained for at least two consecutive weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES improved from -27.4 to -21.1 while TRANSIT improved from -36.6 to -30.4 over the snapshot
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days does not exceed the previous 28-day mean despite continued improvement in WORKPLACES and TRANSIT.

mechanism_narrative: A positive PARKS shock above its recent range pulls weekend leisure demand toward outdoor activities, then spills back into nearby retail and dining visits within one to two weeks. The mechanism predicts a short-run lift in RETAIL_REC when PARKS is clearly positive.
candidate_trigger: PARKS crosses above 0 after at least two weeks below 0
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS moved from -11.6, -7.1, -8.4 to 7.7 in the latest week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to rise within 14 days after PARKS turns positive, or falls despite PARKS staying above zero.

mechanism_narrative: When TRANSIT and WORKPLACES both remain deeply negative, the city is still operating under suppressed commuting and shopping access, so RETAIL_REC stays below the prior four-week mean. This is a persistent drag rather than a rebound signal.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT stayed near -30 and WORKPLACES near -21 to -27 throughout the snapshot
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises above its prior 28-day average while both TRANSIT and WORKPLACES remain below -20 for most of the next month.

mechanism_narrative: An uptick in GROCERY_PHARM above its recent near-zero level signals more out-of-home errand completion and local circulation, which should support retail visits within one week. The effect is immediate and fades quickly if grocery mobility reverts.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM rises by at least 2 points week-on-week
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM improved from -5.3 to -0.7 across the snapshot
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not improve in the next 7 days after GROCERY_PHARM gains at least 2 points week-on-week.

mechanism_narrative: Rising RESIDENTIAL mobility indicates more time spent at home and lower discretionary shopping intensity, so RETAIL_REC should weaken over the next four weeks. This is a substitution effect that is strongest when RESIDENTIAL remains above its recent average.
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL stayed positive near 8 to 11 throughout the snapshot
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases relative to the last 28 days while RESIDENTIAL stays elevated above +5 for most of the next month.

mechanism_narrative: A threshold rebound in PARKS combined with stable GROCERY_PHARM indicates a normalizing leisure-and-errand pattern that can lift retail demand during the next two weeks. If parks activity stays positive while grocery trips do not collapse, retail should improve.
candidate_trigger: PARKS remains above 0 for two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS jumped to 7.7 while GROCERY_PHARM stayed near zero
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not rise within two weeks even though PARKS stays positive and GROCERY_PHARM remains near zero.

mechanism_narrative: If TRANSIT recovers faster than WORKPLACES, the city is likely seeing more discretionary travel than commuting recovery, which should support retail spending over the following month. The signal is conditional on transit improving faster than work mobility.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT improves by more than WORKPLACES over a two-week window
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT and WORKPLACES both improved, but WORKPLACES remained less negative than TRANSIT
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to beat the prior 28-day mean after TRANSIT outperforms WORKPLACES for two consecutive weeks.

mechanism_narrative: A continuing upward drift in RETAIL_REC is most likely when all four outside-home series improve together: GROCERY_PHARM, PARKS, TRANSIT, and WORKPLACES. This broad-based mobility normalization should carry retail higher over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:all four non-residential activity proxies improved by t-0w relative to earlier weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC remains flat or declines over the next 28 days despite simultaneous improvement in GROCERY_PHARM, PARKS, TRANSIT, and WORKPLACES.
